DISCUSS: Beating Ole Miss was huge, but the Gators left at least 28 points on the field
Florida beat No. 4 Ole Miss 52-28, but Franz Beard counts at least 28 points the Gators left on the field: an overthrown Vernell Brown III, an open Amir Jackson on fourth down, a 67-yard touchdown erased by a hold, and eight penalties for 92 yards.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/franz-beard-gators-left-28-points-on-the-field-ole-miss
By Franz Beard. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
